summary: The PR addresses the issue of displaying functools.partial objects in ResolverMatch.__repr__ by unwrapping them and including their underlying function and arguments. The change is well-intentioned and appears to be correct based on the provided diff.

issues.description: The addition of new attributes (partial_args and partial_kwargs) could be documented in the class docstring for clarity.
The string formatting in __repr__ could use f-strings for improved readability, aligning with modern Python practices.
